title: ActionResult
description: One completed action. Written by the agent to its local JSONL journal and mirrored to Firestore. Append-only: a result is never edited after it is written.

status.description: 'no-op' means the action was valid but the desired state already held — a success that changed nothing. Worth telling apart from 'ok' when reading a replayed intent.

committed.description: False for a dry-run or a no-op. True only when bytes actually moved.

detail.description: Human-readable summary. Safe to show in the UI verbatim.

inputs.description: Every parameter the action was constructed with — enough to rebuild and replay it.

outputs.description: What changed. For derived blobs this carries the content-addressed key the web module then fetches.

error.description: Set if and only if status is 'failed'.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC, set when the result object was built.
